# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 42 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 12 tokens; Radius — 9 tokens; Shadow — 8 tokens; Stroke — 5 tokens; Size — 9 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #faf8f3);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #faf8f3;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | paper | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #faf8f3 | Raised cards on the ground: the cost card, metric cards, the closing card, outline pills. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one. The frame's HTML parts. Sizes are at the 470px reference frame; multiply by k = frame width / 470. Everything but the script is uppercase. Newsreader, with optical sizing left on. Only for beats and the end card. Drawn on the scene canvas at the 470px reference width. Each is a single line, so line heights are for HTML use.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 11px/1.3 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-chrome-header); letter-spacing: 0.08em;
font-family: var(--font-mono);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/JetBrainsMono-Latin.woff2`, `fonts/Newsreader-Latin.woff2` and `fonts/Newsreader-Italic-Latin.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/JetBrainsMono-Latin.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/JetBrainsMono-Latin.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| JetBrains Mono | `fonts/JetBrainsMono-Latin.woff2` (weight 400 800) | `read fonts/JetBrainsMono-Latin.woff2` | `var(--font-mono)` | `jetbrains-mono` |
| Newsreader | `fonts/Newsreader-Latin.woff2` (weight 200 800) | `read fonts/Newsreader-Latin.woff2` | `var(--font-serif)` | `newsreader` |

Every face: `fonts/JetBrainsMono-Latin.woff2` (JetBrains Mono, 400 800), `fonts/Newsreader-Latin.woff2` (Newsreader, 200 800), `fonts/Newsreader-Italic-Latin.woff2` (Newsreader, 400, italic).

## Spacing

The episode's own steps at the 470px frame, named by their pixel value. Layout sits on the 14px graph-paper grid.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 2px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-2);
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-2` | 2px | Side padding of the script. |
| `--space-5` | 5px | Gap between deck buttons; a button's side padding. |
| `--space-6` | 6px | Gap in the header; gap between pills in a row. |
| `--space-7` | 7px | A pill's side padding; a button's top and bottom padding. |
| `--space-8` | 8px | Gap between the scrubber and the buttons; the script's bottom padding. |
| `--space-10` | 10px | The deck's inset from the frame edges; gap in the deck's top line. |
| `--space-12` | 12px | The deck's top and bottom padding; the script's top padding. |
| `--space-14` | 14px | The deck's side padding and a card's inner padding. |
| `--space-16` | 16px | The header's side padding; the smallest inset of a card from the frame edge. |
| `--space-20` | 20px | The scene title's inset; the beat statement's top and bottom padding. |
| `--pitch-minor` | 14px | The minor graph-paper pitch. Snap canvas layout to it. |
| `--pitch-major` | 70px | The major graph-paper pitch (5 minor squares). |
